question: Qala, Ajani's Pridemate (a counter for every life gained -- every Shabraz draw is a life gain -- and when she attacks the other attackers get +X power, X her counters) in -- a second shark-sized body that doubles Shabraz's hit -- and for what?

contributions.text:
The deck doctor on study 029 (judged alone; NO CHANGE, the closest call Qala for Library of Leng; only try run, one instrument, 10,000 paired games; no blockers, no removal, so her rows are a ceiling).
- out Willie Lumpkin: damage @T10 172.4 -> 225.9 [+42.6, +64.4]; killed by T6 17.3% -> 17.3% [-0.2, +0.2], no call; extra cards by T8 -1.2; stall +1.2 pts.
- out Valeria Richards: damage @T10 +48.8 [+41.1, +56.5]; killed by T6 +0.0 [-0.1, +0.1], no call; hoard @T10 -0.27.
- out Library of Leng: killed by T6 17.3% -> 17.8% [+0.3, +0.7]; damage @T10 +24.6 [+20.3, +28.9]; 7 better, 4 worse; hoard @T10 4.21 -> 3.23 [-1.24, -0.71]; hand can act by T3 -0.5 pts.
Why no change: the damage @T10 gain lands where the deck already kills 99.5% of goldfish games by T10; the turn-6 kill moves 0 to 0.5 pts. Her weakness is the goldfish's blind spot: a 4-mana 2/3 ground Cat Shabraz cannot fly, who must survive a turn cycle and attack into Purphoros pingers, Krenko and Tiny Bones. Leng was the pilot's approved swap on 2026-11-20. +0.5 pts on a removal magnet is modest, close to a tie. The honest test of Qala is table play or a Forge probe, not another screen.
